source_scope: working checkout source-v10 successor; no source/Docker/full-suite changes

comparison.legacy_oracle: The focused test oracle computes _pack(_bound_uncached(bound, baseline_context))[1], representing the previous full-rebind/full-pack result.
comparison.canonical_and_normalization: Eligible inputs are plain JSON, serialized with sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, and allow_nan=false. Cache key includes the complete serialized [bound_run, baseline_context], not only a digest. Ineligible/nonplain/deep/oversize input falls back to the regular binder path.
comparison.full_semantics_and_limits: On miss, _bound_uncached repeats run/contract/plan/policy/registry/CaseSet validation and bind_run_manifest; _pack performs global depth=16, nodes=100000, integer MAX_INTEGER, and MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES checks. Failed computation is not cached. The key includes _bound_uncached, _pack, _walk_json identities and document/integer limit values.
comparison.source_identity: evaluation_authority._source_digest includes run_evidence and bound validators' source modules, so source edits change the key when normal source identity is refreshed. The shared binding_cache is bounded at 16 MiB/32 entries; JsonCache keys the full input payload (reversibly compressing long text) and caches only immutable string results.
comparison.baseline: baseline_context is serialized with the bound tree and therefore affects the full key and output digest.

focused_validation.warm_hit_dynamic_validator_probe: REPRODUCED: after priming the cache, patching run_evidence.validate_trial_plan to raise still returned the cached digest without invoking the replacement validator. This is an in-process dynamic rebinding case; no external input or production hot-reload path was found.

findings.condition: A cached key exists and a validator/binder global used by _bound_uncached (validate_run_manifest, validate_evaluation_contract, validate_trial_plan, validate_policy_profile, validate_registry, validate_case_set, or bind_run_manifest) is rebound in-process while source digest, _bound_uncached, _pack, _walk_json, limits, and payload remain unchanged.
findings.impact: A warm cache hit skips a currently rebound validator and can return the digest where a cold full _pack(_bound(...)) call would revalidate and reject. This is not a new regression from _cached_bound_digest: code inspection shows the pre-existing _cached_bound warm path also called the same _bound_uncached callable without keying its transitive module-global validators. The focused probe exercised the new digest cache only.
findings.qualification: Normal pinned source changes are covered by source_digest. The reviewed public path exposes no supported hot-reload mechanism, and no untrusted actor can rebind these module globals. This is an inherited dynamic-rebinding limitation, not a newly introduced production correctness regression; exact transitive validator identity is outside the current cache contract.
findings.minimal_resolution: No change is required for the current fixed-source/no-hot-reload contract. If a supported runtime rebinding mechanism is introduced, it must invalidate both bound caches or include that mechanism's callable identities in their keys.

evidence_limit: Only the focused six-test suite and one safe in-process monkeypatch probe were run. No parent-added test, full suite, Docker run, restored source-v10 artifact, or SLO claim is included.
parent_assessment: 既存warm legacy cacheと共通の未サポート動的validator差替制限。新規regressionではない。親追加2件を含む63件は別証跡。
